# Tianlang Light Box

> Professional Exhibition Light Box Manufacturer | Custom SEG Light Boxes, Modular Trade Show Booths, LED Display Systems & OEM/ODM Solutions for Global Brands.

## About Tianlang

Tianlang Light Box specializes in the design, manufacturing, and customization of exhibition display systems. With over 15 years of industry experience, a 4,000㎡ production facility, and a monthly capacity of 3,000 complete light box systems, we provide reliable OEM & ODM services for distributors, exhibition contractors, retailers, and global brands.

---

## Product Categories

- SEG Light Boxes
  https://www.tianlanglightbox.com/seg-light-box/
  Premium illuminated fabric light boxes including 120mm, 85mm, wall-mounted, hanging, freestanding, and custom configurations.

- Foldable SEG Light Boxes
  https://www.tianlanglightbox.com/foldable-seg-light-box/
  Portable double-sided LED light boxes designed for exhibitions, retail promotions, and events.

- Exhibition Booth Systems
  https://www.tianlanglightbox.com/exhibition-booth/
  Modular trade show booths including 10×10ft, 20×10ft, 20×20ft, island booths, and custom exhibition solutions.

- Pop Up Light Boxes
  https://www.tianlanglightbox.com/pop-up-light-box/
  Quick assembly illuminated backdrops for exhibitions, conferences, and brand promotions.

- Hanging Light Boxes
  https://www.tianlanglightbox.com/hanging-light-box/
  Ceiling suspended illuminated displays for maximum exhibition visibility.

- Exhibition Counters & Tables
  https://www.tianlanglightbox.com/light-box-table/
  Illuminated reception counters, SEG tables, storage counters, LED display tables, and custom exhibition furniture.

- Portable Display Systems
  https://www.tianlanglightbox.com/portable-display/
  X Fabric Frame Booths, Quick Show Booths, Pop Up Displays, Roll Up Banners, and Fabric Frame Systems.
